WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return 
    FROM web_returns 
    JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2000 
    WHERE d_year = 2000 
    GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
), 
customer_total_return_filtered AS (
    SELECT ctr1.* 
    FROM customer_total_return ctr1
    JOIN (SELECT ctr_state, AVG(ctr_total_return) OVER (PARTITION BY ctr_state) * 1.2 as avg_ctr_total_return
          FROM customer_total_return) cr ON cr.ctr_state = ctr1.ca_state AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > avg_ctr_total_return
), 
filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ctr_customer_sk, ctr_state
    FROM customer_total_return_filtered
)
SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address AS c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return 
FROM filtered_customers fc 
JOIN customer ON fc.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return 
LIMIT 100
